course.title: 100 Days of Code: The Complete Python Pro Bootcamp
course.provider: Udemy / The App Brewery (Dr. Angela Yu)
course.format: self-paced video bootcamp, 100 daily sections each ending in a project; levels: Beginner (Days 1-14), Intermediate (15-31), Intermediate+ (32-58), Advanced (59-81), Professional Portfolio (82-100)
course.audience: absolute beginners through to aspiring professional developers
course.notes: Udemy course page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so day titles were reconstructed from multiple student GitHub repos that mirror the Udemy section titles; these agree closely. Numbering follows the current (2024+) edition, which inserted 'Day 70: Git, GitHub and Version Control' and moved deployment to Day 71 (Render + gunicorn + PostgreSQL, replacing Heroku); as a result the data-science block is Days 72-81 (vs 71-80 in 2021-2023 editions) and the old 'Predict Earnings using Multivariable Regression' day appears dropped, with Days 99-100 being Space Race and Fatal Force (police deaths) analyses. Older editions differ by one day from Day 70 onward. Days 41-44 (HTML/CSS) were folded in from Angela Yu's web bootcamp in later editions. Days 82-100 are Professional Portfolio projects given only as briefs (no solutions/lectures), so their concepts are inferred from the brief and typical student implementations and are lower confidence; Day 98 is 'Automate Your Life' (open-ended). Day 13 has no main project. Exact sub-lesson topic wording is paraphrased from repos and memory of the course, not copied from Udemy. Some project names (e.g. Day 35 SMS vs Telegram rain alert after Twilio changes) vary by edition.
